name: ZC & ZS Carry Quintile Analysis
description: Corn (ZC) and Soybean (ZS) futures carry quintile study. Ranks all observations by percentrank(period=252) on carry into 5 quintiles (Q1=deepest contango, Q5=deepest backwardation). Shows avg 63-day forward carry and hit rate by quintile as bar charts. Summary table shows obs count, avg carry, avg fwd carry, and hit rate per quintile. Monthly heatmaps show the seasonal distribution of carry quintiles for both ZC and ZS — what fraction of days in each calendar month fall in each quintile.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZC & ZS CARRY QUINTILE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
#
# Quintile sort on corn carry using percentrank(period=252).
# Q1 = deepest contango (pctrank 0-20), Q5 = deepest backwardation (pctrank 80-100).
#
# Forward carry = carry << 63 (lead operator — NOT forward_returns, per S46)
# Hit rate = ternary 1/0 (NOT where(cond, 1.0), per S41)
#
# NoAdjustment for carry computation — price adjustment distorts term structure.
# spread_depth=1 enables cont.carry (M1/M2 ratio) and cont.spread (M1-M2).
#
# ZS loaded via reference_futures + futures_continuation (same methodology).
# Monthly heatmaps: x=month, y=quintile, value=1.0, agg=Mean -> fraction of days.
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZC (primary asset) ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

carry = cont.carry   # M1/M2 - 1: positive = backwardation, negative = contango
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Data: ZS (Soybeans) reference for heatmap comparison ---
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)
zs_carry = zs_cont.carry

# --- Percentrank on carry (dense series — appropriate for percentrank) ---
# period=252 gives ~1 year rolling window
pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(carry)

# --- ZS percentrank (same methodology) ---
zs_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(zs_carry)

# --- Quintile assignment ---
# Q1: pctrank 0-20  (deepest contango)
# Q2: pctrank 20-40
# Q3: pctrank 40-60 (neutral)
# Q4: pctrank 60-80
# Q5: pctrank 80-100 (deepest backwardation)
quintile = conditional_select(
    pctrank <= 20, 1,
    pctrank <= 40, 2,
    pctrank <= 60, 3,
    pctrank <= 80, 4,
    5
)

zs_quintile = conditional_select(
    zs_pctrank <= 20, 1,
    zs_pctrank <= 40, 2,
    zs_pctrank <= 60, 3,
    zs_pctrank <= 80, 4,
    5
)

# --- Forward carry (63-bar lead, per S46 — carry << 63 = carry level in 63 bars) ---
fwd_carry = carry << 63

# --- Hit rate flag: 1 if forward carry is positive, 0 otherwise (ternary per S41) ---
hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_carry) and fwd_carry > 0) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# PER-QUINTILE FILTERED SERIES
# Used for summary table (separate filtered series, not RowSpec groupBy)
# =============================================================================

# Q1 filters
q1_mask = is_valid(quintile) and quintile == 1
q1_carry     = where(q1_mask, carry)
q1_fwd_carry = where(q1_mask, fwd_carry)
q1_hit       = where(q1_mask, hit)
q1_count     = 1.0 if q1_mask else 0.0   # for obs count via Sum

# Q2 filters
q2_mask = is_valid(quintile) and quintile == 2
q2_carry     = where(q2_mask, carry)
q2_fwd_carry = where(q2_mask, fwd_carry)
q2_hit       = where(q2_mask, hit)
q2_count     = 1.0 if q2_mask else 0.0

# Q3 filters
q3_mask = is_valid(quintile) and quintile == 3
q3_carry     = where(q3_mask, carry)
q3_fwd_carry = where(q3_mask, fwd_carry)
q3_hit       = where(q3_mask, hit)
q3_count     = 1.0 if q3_mask else 0.0

# Q4 filters
q4_mask = is_valid(quintile) and quintile == 4
q4_carry     = where(q4_mask, carry)
q4_fwd_carry = where(q4_mask, fwd_carry)
q4_hit       = where(q4_mask, hit)
q4_count     = 1.0 if q4_mask else 0.0

# Q5 filters
q5_mask = is_valid(quintile) and quintile == 5
q5_carry     = where(q5_mask, carry)
q5_fwd_carry = where(q5_mask, fwd_carry)
q5_hit       = where(q5_mask, hit)
q5_count     = 1.0 if q5_mask else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — 5 rows (Q1-Q5) x 4 cols (Obs, Avg Carry, Avg Fwd Carry, Hit Rate)
# Tables first per R10. Separate per-quintile filtered series, not RowSpec groupBy.
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZC Carry Quintile Statistics (63-Day Forward Carry)',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Q1 (Deepest Contango)', 'Q2', 'Q3 (Neutral)', 'Q4', 'Q5 (Deepest Backwardation)'],
        col_headers=['Obs Count', 'Avg Carry', 'Avg Fwd Carry (63d)', 'Hit Rate'],
        cells=[
            # Q1
            ColumnSpec(info='Q1 observation count', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q1 avg carry (M1/M2-1)', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q1 avg 63d forward carry', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q1 hit rate (% fwd carry > 0)', grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Q2
            ColumnSpec(info='Q2 observation count', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q2 avg carry', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q2 avg 63d forward carry', grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q2 hit rate', grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Q3
            ColumnSpec(info='Q3 observation count', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q3 avg carry', grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q3 avg 63d forward carry', grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q3 hit rate', grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Q4
            ColumnSpec(info='Q4 observation count', grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q4 avg carry', grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q4 avg 63d forward carry', grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q4 hit rate', grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Q5
            ColumnSpec(info='Q5 observation count', grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q5 avg carry', grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q5 avg 63d forward carry', grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Q5 hit rate', grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Carry Quintile Analysis',
    order=0
)(
    q1_count, q1_carry, q1_fwd_carry, q1_hit,
    q2_count, q2_carry, q2_fwd_carry, q2_hit,
    q3_count, q3_carry, q3_fwd_carry, q3_hit,
    q4_count, q4_carry, q4_fwd_carry, q4_hit,
    q5_count, q5_carry, q5_fwd_carry, q5_hit
)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Avg 63-Day Forward Carry by Quintile (Grouped bar chart)
# Uses series mode with BarSeriesSchema — one bar per quintile
# color_by_value shows backwardation (positive) green, contango (negative) red
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Does Carry Predict Future Carry? Avg 63-Day Forward Carry by Quintile',
    category='Carry Quintile Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Carry (M1/M2 - 1)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Deepest Contango)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3 (Neutral)', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q5 (Deepest Backwardation)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(q1_fwd_carry, q2_fwd_carry, q3_fwd_carry, q4_fwd_carry, q5_fwd_carry))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Hit Rate by Quintile (% times 63-day forward carry is positive)
# Hit rate is already 0-1 decimal — PercentFormat will display correctly
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='How Often Does Carry Stay Positive? Hit Rate by Quintile',
    category='Carry Quintile Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Hit Rate (% Fwd Carry > 0)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 (Deepest Contango)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3 (Neutral)', color=Color.Gray),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q5 (Deepest Backwardation)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(q1_hit, q2_hit, q3_hit, q4_hit, q5_hit))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 4: ZC Monthly Carry Quintile Frequency Heatmap
# x=month (Jan-Dec), y=quintile (Q1-Q5), value=1.0 per bar, agg=Mean
# Cell value = fraction of days in that (month, quintile) cell -> 0%-100%
# Blue=rare, Orange=frequent — shows which quintiles dominate each month
# =============================================================================
heatmap(
    title='ZC Corn: Which Carry Quintile Dominates Each Month?',
    category='Seasonal Quintile Distribution',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Calendar Month',
    y_axis_label='Carry Quintile',
    min_color=Color.Blue,
    max_color=Color.Orange,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.0%}',
    order=3
)(x=month_num, y=quintile, value=1.0)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 5: ZS Monthly Carry Quintile Frequency Heatmap
# Same methodology applied to soybeans — compare seasonal patterns vs corn
# ZS uses the same month_num (shared timestamp index)
# =============================================================================
heatmap(
    title='ZS Soybeans: Which Carry Quintile Dominates Each Month?',
    category='Seasonal Quintile Distribution',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Calendar Month',
    y_axis_label='Carry Quintile',
    min_color=Color.Blue,
    max_color=Color.Orange,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.0%}',
    order=4
)(x=month_num, y=zs_quintile, value=1.0)
